title: MILO Marathon CDO Leg 2026 Review: Mindanao's Centrio Mall Qualifier
seo_title: MILO Marathon CDO Leg 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: National MILO Marathon 2026 Cagayan de Oro Leg: August 23 at Centrio Mall. RUNRIO's premier series qualifier in the City of Golden Friendship.
dek: Set for 23 August 2026 at Centrio Mall in Cagayan de Oro, this RUNRIO-produced MILO Marathon qualifying leg brings the series to northern Mindanao.
verdict: The MILO Marathon Cagayan de Oro Leg is a RUNRIO-produced MILO series qualifier at Centrio Mall in CDO — Mindanao's 'City of Golden Friendship,' known for white-water rafting on the Cagayan River and its adventure-tourism infrastructure. Five distances from 1K to 21K. RUNRIO's production ensures professional standards. August in CDO is relatively dry by Mindanao standards. A solid MILO series qualifier in one of Mindanao's most dynamic cities.

sections.heading: MILO in the City of Golden Friendship
paragraphs: CDO is northern Mindanao's adventure capital — white-water rafting, zip-lines, and the gateway to Bukidnon's highlands. [1] Centrio Mall provides a central, accessible race hub. RUNRIO's MILO series production is the gold standard in Philippine road racing.
